kassakoppelingAuditLog.title: Kassakoppeling Audit Log
kassakoppelingAuditLog.summary: An append-only, cryptographically signed POS audit entry (Belastingdienst Kassakoppeling).
kassakoppelingAuditLog.description: Immutable hash-chained ledger of every cash-register action (sale, void, refund, no-sale) for Belastingdienst Kassakoppeling compliance. Each entry carries an HMAC-SHA256 signature over its server-authoritative fields plus a SHA-256 currentHash linking it to the previousHash of the prior entry on the same register, forming a tamper-evident chain. Entries are written once via POST only and are never updated or deleted after creation; the signature, hash chain and timestamp are computed server-side and must never be trusted from the client. Mapped to Schema.org Action.

operatorId.description: Nextcloud user UID or external operator identifier of the cashier who performed the action.
operatorId.title: Operator

registerNumber.description: POS register / terminal number, e.g. REG-001.
registerNumber.title: Register

action.description: The cash-register action that was recorded.
action.title: Action

amount.description: Transaction amount in cents (EUR) to avoid floating-point precision loss.
amount.title: Amount

itemCount.description: Number of items in the transaction.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the action (server-stamped, immutable).

transactionUuid.description: Optional UUID reference to a pos-transaction-core transaction for cross-app traceability.

signature.description: HMAC-SHA256 hex digest computed server-side over the entry's authoritative fields and the secret key.

previousHash.description: currentHash of the previous audit entry on the same register, or '0' for the first entry.

currentHash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of this entry's fields and previousHash, forming the tamper-evident chain link.

description.description: Optional operator note, e.g. 'void: customer requested refund'.

verified.description: Verification flag set by a signature/hash-chain check. Null means not yet verified.

exportedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the entry was exported to the Belastingdienst.
